top_signals.title: Goldman: Fed Unlikely to Surprise
top_signals.summary: Goldman Sachs Chief US  Economist David Mericle joins Bloomberg Open Interest to explain why the Fed is still likely to leave interest rates unchanged despite geopolitical tensions and rising oil prices. He breaks down the inflation outlook, why a surprise hike is unlikely, and why today's resilient consumer could weaken later this year. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
